The words सह सुपा meaning 'with a word ending in a case-affix', are to be understood in each of the succeeding aphorisms.

Terms: समास

When the word सह 'with', is joined to a word the latter takes the 3rd case, when the sense is that the word in the 3rd case is not the principal but the accompaniment of the principal thing.

Terms: विभक्ति-3

The affix क्वनिप्‌ comes after the verbs युध 'to fight' and कृ 'to make' with a past signification when the word सह 'with', is in composition.

Terms: क्वनिप्‌

The affix ङीष् does not come in the feminine after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) denoting a part of the body when the word is subordinate in a compound, preceded by the word 1. सह 'with' 2. नञ् 'not' or 3. विद्यमान 'having'.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The affix घ comes in the sense of 'like' after the word सहस्र in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction, in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: घ

स is substituted for सह , in a Name.

Terms: स Substitute

सघ्रि is the substitute of सह before अञ्च् when no affix (or व affix) follows.

Terms: Some Substitution

When ढ् or र् are elided, there is the substitution of ओ or आ of the verbs सह् and वह्।

Terms: Some Substitution

ष् is substituted for the स् in साह when this occurs in the form of साड (साट्).

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि

ष् is substituted for the स् of सह after पृतना and ऋत।

Terms: षत्व change
